nodes.label: Manifest Publication Ordering
nodes.rationale: Sign and upload installer before manifest publication so update prompts never point to missing assets and SHA-256 matches final bytes.

nodes.label: RTK Output Filtering
nodes.rationale: Prefixing shell commands with RTK compresses command output before model context, reducing token use.

nodes.label: Layered Service Architecture
nodes.rationale: Presentation depends on service contracts while technical operations remain in Infrastructure.

nodes.label: Layout-Cycle-Safe WebView Height Feedback
nodes.rationale: DispatcherQueue defers height assignment outside active WinUI layout pass.

nodes.label: Lazy Rich Detail Flow
nodes.rationale: Home and Games use lightweight indexes while rich detail is fetched only when needed.

nodes.label: Catalog Generation Invalidation
nodes.rationale: Monotonic generation plus explicit Home and Games reload avoids a broad live event bus.

nodes.label: Tombstone Cache Cleanup
nodes.rationale: Same-volume rename detaches large caches immediately while deletion continues in background.

nodes.label: Atomic Last-Known-Good Publication
nodes.rationale: Validate completely before atomic replacement so failed downloads cannot erase active data.

nodes.label: Bounded R2 Materialization
nodes.rationale: Fetch only missing AppIDs during Load Games with bounded concurrency and disk reuse.

nodes.label: Native Migration Strategy
nodes.rationale: Retain mature backend behavior while replacing WebView and JavaScript bridge UI with native WinUI.

nodes.label: Small Batch Build Workflow
nodes.rationale: Small changes followed by build and smoke tests prevent broad XAML failures.
